added_failures_note: manifest.md baseline_suite uses baseline-suite-optout.log:194-198 (three failures) and after_suite uses repair-after-suite.log:162-165 (two failures); both head failures are among the baseline failures, so the set difference is empty. assertion_analysis: tests/test_traced_coil_edit.py:13 x64 assertion fails if the dtype setup does not enable x64.
tests/test_traced_coil_edit.py:28-37 HLO sentinel assertions fail if an edited or stored conductor current is embedded as a numeric constant; the original closure mutation produced this failure.
tests/test_traced_coil_edit.py:41-48 state comparisons fail if either current vector is ignored or misweighted against the independent response matrices.
tests/test_traced_coil_edit.py:50 cache-size assertion fails if same-shape edits create multiple compiled variants.
tests/test_traced_coil_edit.py:74-78 typed-request state comparison fails if the second current edit is ignored or misweighted against the fixture response matrices.
tests/test_traced_coil_edit.py:79-81 cache-hit and identity assertions fail if the second request misses the request cache or replaces the retained program.
tests/test_traced_coil_edit.py:109-110 route and qualification assertions fail if explicit pin omission selects the augmented route or the mocked qualified solve loses qualification.
tests/test_traced_coil_edit.py:128-142 legacy lowering assertions fail if either one- or three-operand calls are no longer callable.

tests/test_traced_coil_edit.py:200-214 seed and receipt assertions fail if a nonconverged terminal state advances the seed, if a converged state does not, or if zero persistent hits and nonconvergence are omitted from acceptance failures.
tests/test_traced_coil_edit.py:222-223 exit assertion fails if the command returns successfully when its summary reports an acceptance failure.
No added assertion compares its result only to the variable it passed into the code under test; state expectations use response matrices, and the seed expectations use fixed mock outputs.

findings.text: blocking: the only complete H200 sweep predates the repair and fails the quantitative gate at 6107.488 ms warm median, 19/20 converged, and zero persistent hits after the first edit; no repaired hardware receipt establishes the required result.

blocking: the gate requires a persistent compilation-cache hit event on every later edit, although the measured retained executable serves all 19 later edits without any cache lookup; this predicate rejects in-process program reuse and cannot verify persistent-cache reuse on that path.
